name: AIButton
description: The AI call to action. Gradient primary, outlined secondary, ghost tertiary. Status is part of the contract: loading, complete and error are visual states the caller drives from real work.
intent: Commit to something a machine proposed.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: variant
props.hint: See variantGuidance in the mirror spec for when to use each.

props.name: size
props.hint: See sizeGuidance in the mirror spec.

props.name: status
props.hint: One of the status values declared in aiButtonVariants.

props.name: label
props.hint: Required. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: label is required — there is no icon-only form
notes: status="loading" sets aria-busy and disables the button, so the action cannot be double-fired.
The status icon is aria-hidden; the label must change to carry the meaning ("Applying…", "Applied").
The error state colours the button but does not explain the failure. Render the reason adjacent.

agentRules: Only for actions originating from AI output. Standard actions use ui:button.
status must track real work — never animate loading to simulate effort.
Change the label with the status; the icon alone is not announced.
On error, say what failed and what the user can do next.
